category.quote: Only candidates who belong to Scheduled Castes and have passed the Matriculation, Higher Secondary, or a higher examination of a recognized university or Board of Secondary Education are eligible.

social_category.quote: Only candidates who belong to Scheduled Castes and have passed the Matriculation, Higher Secondary, or a higher examination of a recognized university or Board of Secondary Education are eligible.

income_band.quote: Scholarships will be paid to students whose parents' or guardians' income from all sources does not exceed ₹ 2,50,000/- per annum.

gate_notes: Only Indian nationals are eligible - The scholarships are open to Indian nationals only.
Must have passed Matriculation, Higher Secondary or higher examination of a recognized university or Board.
Candidates who are studying in the same stage of education in a different subject after passing one stage of education are not eligible.
A scholarship holder under this scheme will not hold any other scholarship or stipend.
Students studying through correspondence/online courses shall not be eligible for academic allowance per Note 2.
